scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'out', 'data', '../../.turbo', '../../apps/core/models', '../../apps/core/data'].forEach(p => { if (fs.existsSync(p)) { console.log('Cleaning ' + p); fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); } })"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:node && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.prebuild: node -e "const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const cmd = isWin ? 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/hydrate-bin.ps1' : 'bash scripts/hydrate-bin.sh'; require('child_process').execSync(cmd, {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.build: npm run prebuild && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.build:unpack: npm run build && electron-builder --dir && npm run validate:llama:package
scripts.build:win: npm run build && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false', CSC_LINK: '', CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: '', WIN_CSC_LINK: '', WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: '' }; execSync('electron-builder --win nsis -p never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false --config.forceCodeSigning=false', { stdio: 'inherit', env });" && node scripts/validate-llama-package.js dist/win-unpacked/resources --platform=win32
scripts.build:win_clean: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:win
scripts.build:appx:all: npm run build && pnpm run build:appx:store && pnpm run build:appx:test
scripts.build:appx:store: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false', CSC_LINK: '', CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: '', WIN_CSC_LINK: '', WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: '' }; execSync('electron-builder --win appx -p never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false --config.forceCodeSigning=false', { stdio: 'inherit', env });" && node scripts/stamp-exe.js
scripts.build:appx:test: node scripts/ensure-cert.js && node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); const env = { ...process.env, CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false', CSC_LINK: '', CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: '', WIN_CSC_LINK: '', WIN_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: '' }; execSync('electron-builder --win appx -p never --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false --config.forceCodeSigning=false --config.appx.displayName=\"MomAI - Teste\" --config.win.artifactName=\"MomAI-Teste.${ext}\"', { stdio: 'inherit', env });" && node scripts/sign-appx.js && node scripts/stamp-exe.js
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux -p never && node scripts/validate-llama-package.js dist/linux-unpacked/resources --platform=linux
